title: Check Geek+ Overall System RMS for system faults and active AGV faults
summary: Use the Geek+ RMS web page “Overall System RMS” view to determine whether the site currently has system faults (left area) and whether any active AGV faults are present (right area).
when_to_use: When a support caller needs a first-pass check of the site’s current fault state and active AGV fault presence using the Geek+ RMS “Overall System RMS” web page layout.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the first-pass check on the Geek+ RMS “Overall System RMS” web page and report whether system faults are shown (left) and whether active AGV faults are shown (right).
access_or_tools_needed: Overall System RMS page visibility (system faults left panel; active AGV faults right panel)

access_required: Access to the Geek+ RMS web page for the site’s “Overall System RMS” view

visual_references.description: Overall System RMS page frame showing the Geek+ RMS web page layout with system faults on the left and active AGV faults on the right.

steps.title: Open the Geek+ RMS “Overall System RMS” view
steps.purpose: Get to the specific Geek+ RMS web page layout where system faults and active AGV faults are displayed in separate left/right areas.
steps.instruction: Open the Geek+ RMS web page for the site’s “Overall System RMS” view so you can see the page layout with system faults on the left and active AGV faults on the right.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System RMS” page is visible and shows the left-side system faults area and the right-side active AGV faults area.
steps.healthy_condition: Both the left and right fault areas are visible on the “Overall System RMS” page.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load, or the system faults/active AGV faults areas are not visible.

actions.label: Verify Overall System RMS layout is visible
actions.exact_action: Open the Geek+ RMS web page for the site’s “Overall System RMS” view.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not load or the faults areas are not visible, escalate to the appropriate support level for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR: “Overall System RMS ... This page will show the Geek+ RMS web page ... will also show system faults on the left and any ... active AGV faults on the right.”

steps.title: Check the left-side “system faults” area
steps.purpose: Determine whether any system faults are currently present, as indicated by entries in the left-side system faults area.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System RMS” page, look at the left side “system faults” area and note whether any system faults are shown.
steps.expected_result: You can report whether the left-side “system faults” area shows entries (system faults present) or shows none (no system faults shown).
steps.healthy_condition: The left-side “system faults” area shows no entries (no system faults shown).
steps.failure_condition: The left-side “system faults” area shows one or more entries (system faults present).

actions.label: Inspect system faults panel
actions.exact_action: On the left side of the page, look for the “system faults” area and note whether any system faults are shown.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR: “... will also show system faults on the left ...”
Transcript: “Do you have any system faults, right? Should be the first question.”

steps.title: Check the right-side “active AGV faults” area
steps.purpose: Determine whether any active AGV faults are currently present, as indicated by entries in the right-side active AGV faults area.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System RMS” page, look at the right side “active AGV faults” area and note whether any active AGV faults are shown.
steps.expected_result: You can report whether the right-side “active AGV faults” area shows entries (active AGV faults present) or shows none (no active AGV faults shown).
steps.healthy_condition: The right-side “active AGV faults” area shows no entries (no active AGV faults shown).
steps.failure_condition: The right-side “active AGV faults” area shows one or more entries (active AGV faults present).

actions.label: Inspect active AGV faults panel
actions.exact_action: On the right side of the page, look for the “active AGV faults” area and note whether any active AGV faults are shown.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: OCR: “... and any ... active AGV faults on the right.”

steps.title: Report presence/absence of faults from the Overall System RMS page
steps.purpose: Provide the first-pass fault state evidence during the support call based on what is shown on the page.
steps.instruction: Use the presence/absence of entries in the left “system faults” area and right “active AGV faults” area as your initial evidence to report back during the support call.
steps.expected_result: You can clearly state: (1) whether system faults are shown on the left, and (2) whether active AGV faults are shown on the right.
steps.healthy_condition: Your report matches what is displayed: left side reflects system faults presence/absence; right side reflects active AGV faults presence/absence.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot determine the fault presence/absence because the page is not accessible or the fault areas are not visible.

actions.label: Provide first-pass fault status
actions.exact_action: Use the presence/absence of entries in those two areas as the initial evidence to report back during the support call.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the user cannot access/share the HMI screen, rely on the described RMS web page view instead.
If the page does not load or the faults areas are not visible, escalate to the appropriate support level for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: Transcript (near 02:15:57): “Most people that's gonna be calling you will not be able to share their screen on this... it's not for the HMI ... does not have access to share the screen... but through a web ...”
Transcript: “Do you have any system faults, right? Should be the first question.”

success_criteria: Left-side “system faults” area presence/absence is determined and can be reported.
Right-side “active AGV faults” area presence/absence is determined and can be reported.
healthy_conditions: No system faults shown on the left-side “system faults” area.
No active AGV faults shown on the right-side “active AGV faults” area.
failure_conditions: System faults are shown in the left-side “system faults” area.
Active AGV faults are shown in the right-side “active AGV faults” area.
Geek+ RMS “Overall System RMS” page does not load or fault areas are not visible.
escalation_guidance: If the page does not load or the faults areas are not visible, escalate to the appropriate support level for further investigation.
